experimental/vibe/codegen/cpp/src/facade.rs: 1

`491-491`: ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Escape comment openers as well as terminators.** If documentation contains `Use /* ... */ for comments.`, this emits `Use /* ... * / for comments.` inside a block comment. GCC diagnoses the remaining `/*` with `-Wcomment`, enabled by `-Wall`. Consumers using `-Wall -Werror` cannot compile that header. ([gcc.gnu.org](https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gcc/Warning-Options.html?utm_source=openai)) Also rewrite `/*` to `/ *`. Add a regression case containing both delimiters. This preserves ordinary prose and keeps literal terminators escaped.
